title: classical-spacetime
description: The codomain of collapsing: the scott rung, generated when value enters the amplitude fibration (measurement). Is the kernel's scott-posit-category — a valued presheaf, definite local sections; physically classical mechanics, the cosmic-scott band (golden φ), 'natural existence as we experience it now'. The old cosmic-predicating tower is being merged in here (cosmic-scott was always this field): the measurement (observing + cosmology, the field reading itself from within — no external correspondence) is homed; the cosmos content and the thermalizing generator are the next merges.
